paper.title_en: Perturbations of black holes with primary hair: time evolutions, quasinormal modes and greybody factors
paper.abstract_en: In this work we study gravitational perturbations of black holes carrying primary scalar hair in shift-symmetric beyond-Horndeski gravity. By focusing on the axial sector, we study the geometric structure of the perturbation equations and perform time-domain evolutions both in the physical and in the effective metric descriptions, in order to quantify differences in the response characteristics of solutions with different hair. In the frequency domain, we then explore the QNM spectrum in the physical-metric formulation, thus verifying and extending existing approximate calculations derived in the effective-metric approach. We also compute the corresponding greybody factors and absorption cross-sections. Finally, we use localized deformations of the effective potential as a diagnostic of the relative stability of quasinormal frequencies and greybody-factor observables.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了带primary标量毛的黑洞的引力扰动，包括时域演化、拟正规模式和灰体因子，与黑洞热力学和广义相对论基础相关，具有较高的理论深度和方法严谨性。
decision.title_zh: 具有primary毛的黑洞的扰动：时间演化、拟正规模式和灰体因子
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了在平移对称的beyond-Horndeski引力中携带primary标量毛的黑洞的引力扰动。通过关注轴向扇区，我们研究了扰动方程的几何结构，并在物理度规和有效度规描述中进行了时域演化，以量化具有不同毛的解决方案的响应特征差异。在频域中，我们随后在物理度规表述中探索了QNM谱，从而验证并扩展了在有效度规方法中得出的现有近似计算。我们还计算了相应的灰体因子和吸收截面。最后，我们使用有效势的局部变形作为拟正规频率和灰体因子可观测量的相对稳定性的诊断。
